Edward Farr, ed.  Select Poetry of the Reign of Queen Elizabeth.  1845.

Faith

LXII. William Warner

’T
IS
 onely faith doth justifie,
Say we, of God’s free grace
By Christ; nor faith is idle, but
Doth charitie embrace.
